gen-fs-kola-plus-jakarta-sans: Loud and low-slung, with plenty of attitude. Kola does its best work in a few bold words, while Plus Jakarta Sans, a sans-serif with tubing-like curves and one steady gauge, carries the rest.
gen-fs-merriweather-sans-fs-karma: Cozy sums up Merriweather Sans, whose big counters let you see right into each curve. Karma, a text serif with weighty stems and terminals clear of the stem, adds a trustworthy, classic counterpoint.
gen-fs-merriweather-sans-roboto-slab: Big-hearted letters meet sturdy ones: Merriweather Sans opens its curves wide while Roboto Slab, a slab-serif, stays structured. Merriweather Sans really earns its keep when it's big and brief.
gen-fs-new-title-cabin: Tall, chain-tight, and bold. New Title leads, then Cabin, a warm sans with open terminals, makes extended reading go down smoothly, its bent-tube letterforms never tiring the eye over time.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-erode: New Title's lowercase stands unusually tall, its letters locked together like links in a fine chain. Erode, a text serif with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, lets extended reading move along with quiet dignity.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-karma: Slender turns meet robust downstrokes in the body text, which reads trustworthy and classic. Karma feels quiet, settled, and sure of itself beside New Title's loud, tall, chain-linked letters.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-pally: Pally, a sans-serif built on one fixed nib width and open c shapes, sits under New Title's tall, bold chain of letters. Extended paragraphs of it would feel relaxed, clean, and quietly unhurried.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with caps barely taller than its lowercase. Beneath New Title's tall, chain-linked display letters, that serif keeps things friendly, so the bold top never overwhelms.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-roundo: New Title packs tall lowercase into tight, chain-like rows. What stands out most is lowercase height, towering in New Title but moderate in Roundo, a sans-serif with unclogged counters.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-spline-sans: New Title is bold, tall in the lowercase, and linked like a fine chain. Spline Sans, a sans-serif with wide curve gaps, drops to a moderate lowercase height, and that contrast with the heading is the draw.
